## Install

Download `Questie-335-latest.zip`, extract it outside your WoW folder, close WoW and run `Install-Questie.cmd`. It downloads this commit of `335` from GitHub, verifies every file and installs `Questie-335`; the old folder is backed up and SavedVariables are kept.

Use it with the matching server from the [mod-playerbots-portable Latest release](https://github.com/Syntax555/mod-playerbots-portable/releases/latest). Changes compared to [Aldori15/Questie](https://github.com/Aldori15/Questie) are listed in this fork's [README](https://github.com/Syntax555/Questie#mod-playerbots-portable-fork).
